label: Fire Damage
description: Deals SL Fire damage to the target.

label: Frost Damage
description: Deals SL Frost damage to the target.

label: Shock Damage
description: Deals SL Shock damage to the target.

label: Drain Health
description: Drains SL Health from the target for the duration.

label: Drain Magicka
description: Drains SL Magicka from the target for the duration.

label: Drain Stamina
description: Drains SL Stamina from the target for the duration.

label: Absorb Health
description: Transfers SL Health from the target to the caster.

label: Absorb Magicka
description: Transfers SL Magicka from the target to the caster.

label: Dispel
description: Attempts to dispel magical effects on the target with Dispel Strength = SL.

label: Soul Trap
description: Marks the target's soul. If the target dies while the effect is active, their soul is trapped in a soul gem held by the caster.
notes: Fixed cost 50. Duration must be set; Upkeep keeps it active.

label: Disintegrate
description: Applies the Damaged(X) quality to target's equipped weapon or armor based on SL.

label: Paralyze
description: Inflicts the Paralyzed condition on the target. SL determines duration.

label: Silence
description: Inflicts the Silenced condition on the target. SL determines duration.

label: Slow Fall
description: Reduces or negates fall damage for the caster/target.

label: Feather
description: Reduces the target's Encumbrance by SL * 5 for the duration.

label: Burden
description: Increases the target's Encumbrance by SL * 5 for the duration.

label: Fortify Attribute
description: Temporarily increases a chosen attribute by SL * 5 for the duration.

label: Restore Health
description: Restores SL Health instantly (or over time if Upkeep).

label: Restore Magicka
description: Restores SL Magicka instantly.

label: Restore Stamina
description: Restores SL Stamina instantly.

label: Shield
description: Provides SL Magic Armor Rating to the target for the duration.

label: Night Eye
description: Grants the target the ability to see in darkness. SL determines effectiveness.

label: Chameleon
description: Partially or fully renders the target invisible. SL determines transparency level.

label: Invisibility
description: Renders the target fully invisible until they take an action that breaks invisibility.

label: Calm
description: Calms the target, preventing aggressive actions while active.

label: Frenzy
description: Forces the target to attack the nearest creature.

label: Demoralize
description: Forces the target to flee in fear.

label: Waterbreathing
description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for the duration.

label: Levitation
description: Allows the target to levitate and move through the air.

label: Become Ethereal
description: Renders the target incorporeal: immune to physical damage but cannot attack. CANNOT be used in Constant enchantments.
notes: RAW: Cannot be used in Constant enchantments.

label: Open Lock
description: Attempts to open a locked container or door. SL determines lock difficulty overcome.

label: Detect Life
description: Reveals living creatures within SL * 5 metres.

label: Detect Dead
description: Reveals undead creatures within SL * 5 metres.

label: Turn Undead
description: Forces undead creatures to flee. SL determines difficulty of undead affected.

label: Summon Creature
description: Summons a creature of SL power to serve the caster. CANNOT be used in Constant enchantments (Conjuration restriction).
notes: RAW: Conjuration effects cannot be used in Constant enchantments.

label: Bound Weapon
description: Conjures a bound weapon of SL tier for the caster to wield. CANNOT be used in Constant enchantments (Conjuration restriction).
notes: RAW: Conjuration effects cannot be used in Constant enchantments.
